title: Nike Basketball and Devin Booker Introduce the Nike Book 3, Built for Court Feel and Timeless Style
summary: The Nike Book 3 is the next evolution of Devin Booker’s signature basketball franchise, built at the intersection of responsive performance and timeless, everyday style.
body_markdown:
Nike Basketball and Devin Booker are introducing the Nike Book 3, the next evolution of a signature franchise built at the intersection of performance basketball and timeless style.


The Book 3 begins a new chapter in[Booker’s signature Nike lineage](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/nike-book-2-official-images-release-info) , advancing a footwear franchise defined by connection to the court and versatility beyond it. Created for athletes who prioritize responsiveness, freedom of movement and court feel, the shoe balances a new, athlete-curated performance system with the classic, wearable design language that’s become central to the Book line.


“Every Book starts with how I want to feel on the court, and the Book 3 takes that experience to another level,” says Booker. “We spent a lot of time getting the fit and performance right, then built a clean, timeless design that reflects what’s important to me off the court, ending up with a shoe that feels true to me and is easy to wear every day.”


At the center of the Book 3 performance system is a forefoot Zoom Strobel implementation that places responsive cushioning directly underfoot, adding more Zoom and reinforcing the low-to-the-ground court feel that athletes expect from Booker’s signature footwear. A Cushlon 3.0 midsole balances standout responsiveness with all-game comfort, while a TPU shank adds support and stability for rapid changes in direction. All the while, a modernized herringbone traction pattern helps players command the court in confidence.


The configuration is grounded in athlete preference. During development, Booker tested multiple cushioning and Zoom setups before arriving at the combination that best reflected his preferred ride. Nike engineers applied those performance insights to create a responsive, flexible and stable silhouette that serves today’s positionless hooper in style.


A predominantly mesh construction and varied overlay executions give the Book 3 a modern, wearable look. The design moves away from some of the more experimental molded constructions explored earlier in Booker’s signature footwear lineage, reinforcing an identity that feels premium, performance-ready and natural to wear away from the game.


The Sun launch colorway continues Booker’s history of opening each signature model in orange, while apparel and future seasonal stories further connect the franchise to the city he represents, Arizona culture and his personal point of view.


“Phoenix is a big part of who I am, so I wanted my first Book 3 to reflect the city in a real way,” says Booker. “The colors, materials and details are inspired by the Arizona landscape and the energy of Phoenix, and the shoe has a clean, timeless design that moves naturally from the court to everyday life. It’s the best Book yet.”


Booker’s connection to the region he represents extends to a refreshed signature apparel collection shaped by his interests, Arizona geography and Americana influences.


Premium sportswear silhouettes include a corduroy basketball warm-up tracksuit, rib-knit fleece set, quilted wool jacket, heavyweight ringer T-shirt and coordinated lineup of shorts.


Copper-inspired zipper pulls, trims, ingot references and souvenir penny-style hardware draw from Arizona’s copper identity, and a custom Arizona toile brings together landscape imagery, tire tracks, dog paw prints, cacti, scorpions and basketball references across multiple pieces in the collection.


The unified footwear and apparel collection underscores Booker’s unique ability to connect performance, personal style and his varied cultural interests, giving the Nike Book franchise a distinct voice in the contemporary basketball landscape.


The Nike Book 3 and accompanying apparel collection will be available in spring 2027 at[nike.com](https://www.nike.com/) and select retail locations.


***NIKE, Inc. is providing a sneak peek of the Book 3 as part of its World of Athletes* event, which offers an exclusive first look into some of the footwear and apparel that will debut in seasons to come. View the showcase***[here](https://about.nike.com/en/topics/inside-nike-strategy) ***.***


** If you have a body, you are an athlete.*
